acip: GNYIS PA NI, RTAG CHAD KYI MTHA' DANG BRAL BA'I DNGOS PO BDEN MED DU RTOGS PA'I LTA BA KHAS LEN PAS NA, DBU MA PA DANG,
wylie: gnyis pa ni, rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i dngos po bden med du rtogs pa'i lta ba khas len pas na, dbu ma pa dang
english: As for our second point—the literal meaning of the name “Middle Way”—those who adhere to this system are referred to as “practitioners of the Middle Way” because they accept a viewpoint in which we finally realize that there is no entity in the universe which exists in truth—and thus free ourselves forever from the two extremes of things having to exist forever, or things suddenly stopping altogether.
